# Growth Architect Foundry

> Multi-tenant agency growth engine with 23 deterministic commands. Not prompts pretending to be software.

## What it is
A Claude Code plugin and standalone CLI for marketing agencies. One kernel, unlimited clients. Every command is deterministic Python — same input, same output, every time. No LLM calls in the command layer; judgment work stays in the AI interface (skills and agents).

## Commands (23)
Account: `audit`, `diagnose`, `report` (EN/AR)
Economics: `calc breakeven`, `calc cod`, `calc learning`, `calc vat`
Campaigns: `list`, `status`, `compare`
Content: `pipeline`, `calendar`
Tracking: `check`, `events`
Leads: `score`
Creative: `hooks`, `angles`
Competitive: `audit`
Seasonal: `plan`
Forecast: `project`
Ops: `status`, `cadence`
Tenants: `list`

## Installation
Claude Code: `/plugin install growth-architect-foundry@growth-architect-foundry`
Manual: `./scripts/install.sh --dir ~/.claude/skills`
Standalone: `python foundry.py account audit --client Aurora_Skincare`

## Safety
- Read-only by default on live accounts
- Maker/checker: no auto-send, no auto-publish, no auto-commit
- Every finding labeled confirmed-by-data or hypothesis
- Money figures from deterministic calc.py, not from AI guessing
- Multi-tenant: each client's .env and secrets isolated per-folder

## Token budget
~800 tokens/session for the router skill. Deep references load lazily per command.
